parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give one reason for each of the following rules when making shortcrust pastry:

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: sieve flour ______

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: use fingertips for rubbing in ______

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: use plain flour ______

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text: use butter ______

parts.label: (v)
parts.text: do not add too much water ______

parts.label: (vi)
parts.text: allow pastry to relax in a cool place before baking. ______

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The shortcrust pastry can be used to make a fruit pie. The pie can be glazed with egg or milk
before baking to give it an attractive appearance.
Suggest four other methods that can be used before baking to give the pie an attractive
appearance.

parts.label: (c)

cold water
